dialect.detail: NIST CCVS (COBOL Compiler Validation System) test suite, version 4.2. Uses placeholder computer names (XXXXX082, XXXXX083) and file assign names (XXXXX001, XXXXX014, XXXXX055) typical of NIST CCVS portability conventions. Program SQ205A tests USE statement with sequential files (XFILE-NA series).

purpose.domain_detail: NIST COBOL Compiler Validation System (CCVS) - sequential file USE statement testing
purpose.summary: This is a NIST CCVS test program (SQ205A) that validates the USE statement with sequential files. It creates and reads two sequential files (a mass storage file and a tape file), tests AT END conditions to trigger USE procedures, and verifies FILE STATUS clause behavior in the SELECT statement. Results are written to a print file with pass/fail reporting.

notable_features: NIST CCVS test harness boilerplate (CCVS-C-1, CCVS-C-2, TEST-RESULTS, TEST-COMPUTED, TEST-CORRECT)
FILE STATUS clause on both sequential files (GRP-STATUS-KEY-1, GRP-STATUS-KEY-2)
BLOCK CONTAINS 5 RECORDS on sequential FDs
REDEFINES used for numeric picture variants in test output records
High GOTO count (41) typical of CCVS test flow
verdict.notes: File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 46425 bytes (573 lines total shown partially). All evidence strongly points to NIST CCVS test suite. The sequence numbers in columns 73-80 (SQ2054.2) confirm this is revision 2 of the SQ2054 test module. No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS.
